claude.rationale: The slice documents that the acquired China business was wound down and closed in fiscal 2014, with a net tax benefit tied to an intercompany loan write-off and no further China operating presence in FY2015-2016. However, the slice records only the fact and financial effect of the closure and does not attribute the wind-down to any product/operations incoherence (p4) or to any operations-vs-organization/culture fracture (p5); no causal disruption at either interface is described. With the realized outcome established but the failure mechanism undocumented, both pathway interfaces are coded uncertain rather than assumed.
